_comment: Settings for the automated dependency updates (.github/workflows/dependency-updates.yml).
_lockstep: Packages that must always share one version. They are updated together, to the lowest version all of them have published.
_ignore: Never touched at all (exact names). @vercel/blob is held back on purpose: newer releases pull a transitive zod with an open npm-audit advisory; lift this once that is fixed upstream.
_ignoreMajor: Minor/patch updates only. @types/node must follow the Node.js version used in CI/Vercel (22). typescript: a new major (native compiler) is adopted by hand once Next/typescript-eslint support it. eslint-config-next/eslint follow Next.
